scope: Device identification cards only. No operational commissioning, wiring or interoperability guarantee is inferred from shared appearance.
image_processing: Original manufacturer pixels; alpha flattened onto white, maximum 1200 px, WebP quality 93. PDF illustrations extracted by exact image XRef from inspected page 1. No generated imagery.

devices.model_evidence: White 6000PLUS head with dark chamber openings and a grey centre ring in the manufacturer photo. Confirm the OP label.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: Optical-only model. Similar 6000PLUS housings include heat, multisensor, sounder and VAD versions; the picture does not identify those functions.
devices.verified_document_mark: Manufacturer tech-sheet PDF; Issue 0 in source filename

devices.model_evidence: Manufacturer photo shows a red centre ring on the white 6000PLUS head. Confirm HT on the device label.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: Heat-only head; not the OP optical detector or an HT/S sounder variant. Use the matching panel configuration and head documentation.
devices.verified_document_mark: Manufacturer tech-sheet PDF; Issue 0 in source filename

devices.model_evidence: Optical smoke, heat and carbon-monoxide fire sensor in the 6000PLUS housing. Manufacturer photo has a black centre ring; check the full OPHTCO label.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: This is the plain OPHTCO head. Sounder, speech and VAD suffixes are different variants; its CO element does not make it a domestic CO alarm.

devices.model_evidence: Red indoor call point with resettable element and Protec branding. Check the 6000/MCP label because conventional models share this front style.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: UK 6000/MCP entry. The linked sheet also lists NL and EXP editions; it does not establish that their configurations are interchangeable. Indoor housing only.

devices.model_evidence: Deep red weatherproof enclosure with top cable entries and resettable element. Confirm the 6000/MCP/WP code.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: Weatherproof UK variant, distinct from the shallow indoor MCP and the EXP version. Shared housing does not establish conventional/addressable compatibility.

devices.model_evidence: White circular surface base shown without a detector head. Its terminal layout and label distinguish it from the fast-fix base.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: Base only; the detector is separate. The linked sheet specifies 6000PLUS heads and does not establish compatibility with another manufacturer’s heads.
devices.verified_document_mark: Manufacturer tech-sheet PDF; Issue 0 in source filename

devices.model_evidence: Green DIN-rail interface board illustrated in the exact 6000/2IO tech sheet TEC0053/0 (08/25). Confirm the 6000/2IO label on the installed unit.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: 6000/2IO only. Other Protec interfaces use similar housings; the matched tech sheet governs supported panels, inputs and contact loads.
devices.rejection_reason: Product page used a different board image. Replaced with the exact 6000/2IO datasheet illustration after independent visual review.

devices.model_evidence: Local alarm faceplate with three status indicators and a MUTE button. This is the loop-connected local control module.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: The LCM manages its specified local detector and sounder circuits. It is not a generic silence control or a replacement for the main fire panel.

devices.model_evidence: Transparent duct housing shown with a detector head. The same housing is used by addressable and conventional UG4DP assemblies.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: Confirm the fitted 6000PLUS/OP or 3000PLUS/OP head and assembly label. Heads are sold separately; the photo does not distinguish protocol. Datasheet ordering suffix needs supplier confirmation.

literal_code_check.evidence: Both strings are printed verbatim in the page 1 headline/bullets of MED1516 Issue 4. No suffix was inferred. The inconsistent 6000PLUS/UG4DP6 ordering-block spelling is not added as an assumed code.

devices.model_evidence: Red horn-style wall sounder with a separate clear VAD lens below the sounder opening.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: Red wall-mounted sounder/VAD model. The white SSW/VAD and sounder-only SSR variants are separate; mounting and coverage depend on the exact specification.

devices.model_evidence: Black metal damper-control enclosure with a labelled front indicator panel. Check the DCM label and enclosure option.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: Smoke damper interface, not a generic sounder or zone module. The sheet covers enclosure options and specified actuator supplies; field wiring and legacy DIU mode require the exact instructions.

devices.model_evidence: Cream plate marked FIRE ALARM and ZONE ALARM INTERFACE UNIT. Confirm LPZA on the internal label; APZA units can share the exterior.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: LPZA connects its specified conventional detector zone and sounder circuit to a Protec loop. The shared photo cannot establish the power arrangement or supported devices.

review_notes: All 12 downloaded datasheets match the existing catalogue SHA-256 values. No replacement document records are required.
Product page image filenames for 6000/MCP and MCP/WP contain 3000; the current manufacturer pages explicitly identify their 6000 models. Shared front appearance is disclosed.

6000/2IO product-page image was rejected because its 2APZA board differs visibly from the exact 2IO datasheet figure. The delivered card now uses page 1, XRef 26 of 6000-2IO-Tech-sheet-Issue-0.pdf (TEC0053/0 08/25).

UG4DP datasheet MED1516 Issue 4 uses 6000PLUS/UG4DP in the title and description but 6000PLUS/UG4DP6 in its ordering block. Card keeps the published family codes and asks for ordering-suffix confirmation; no guessed suffix is added.
APZA and LPZA share the source photo; the LPZA code and loop-powered behaviour are separately confirmed by the exact sheet.
visual_review: Each final card image was inspected on the per-brand contact sheet and compared with its source product page or manufacturer PDF illustration. Shared housing, assembled-head/base and edition limitations were retained.
